01 / Context

The problem

Application changes break regression tests, creating recurring investigation and script maintenance.

My contribution

Developed synchronous orchestration and backend pipelines using Python and LangChain.

02 / Workflow

Workflow

  1. Detect a broken script

    A script breakage triggers the maintenance workflow.

  2. Correlate defect reports

    The Auto Defect Management system supplies confirmed reports as application-change signals.

  3. Orchestrate a repair

    Custom Python and LangChain coordinate the synchronous maintenance workflow.

  4. Update the test code

    The workflow produces script changes intended to address the breakage.

03 / Architecture

Architecture

Decision and orchestration layer

Python and LangChain coordinate synchronous decisions and workflows.

Defect workflow bridge

Auto Defect Management supplies confirmed change signals.

Tracing and observability

LangSmith traces LLM calls; OpenTelemetry supports observability.

Development tooling

GitHub Copilot supports Python and LangChain development.

  • Python
  • LangChain
  • LangSmith
  • OpenTelemetry
  • GitHub Copilot

04 / Engineering decisions

Controls and trade-offs

Connect maintenance to diagnostic context

Use confirmed defect reports to guide script maintenance.

Keep the execution model explicit

Keep orchestration synchronous in Python and LangChain.

Trace the orchestration

Use LangSmith and OpenTelemetry to inspect workflow execution.

Development status

Internal system in development. My contribution covers backend orchestration and pipelines.
